vb_textbox.text: There seemed to be trends that would favour one particular gnome in a pair for a certain period which would changer after a certain period of time. Once you feel this trend is ending it may be worth considering switching gnomes. I felt the trends were shorter in the second half of the game and there were lean periods at other times no matter the gnome. Generally, use your instincts to try and catch the trends at their highest.
